package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiagnosticPlanMigrationIsImmutableAndBindsJSON(t *testing.T) {
	b, e := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/011_diagnostic_assessment_plan.up.sql")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	s := string(b)
	for _, want := range []string{"BEGIN;", "CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_diagnostic_assessment_plan", "BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE", "plan_json->>'id'=id::text", "plan_json->>'plan_digest'=plan_digest", "plan_json->>'created_at'", "::timestamptz = created_at", "ELSE false", "jsonb_array_length(plan_json->'assessments') BETWEEN 3 AND 5", "^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$"} {
		if !strings.Contains(s, want) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", want)
		}
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticDeliveryAndPlacementMigrationBindsOnlySafeAggregateReceipts(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/012_diagnostic_assessment_delivery_and_placement.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := string(b)
	for _, want := range []string{"CREATE TABLE diagnostic_assessment_reservation_receipt", "CREATE TABLE diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision", "FOREIGN KEY (plan_id, student_id, course_id, plan_revision, plan_digest)", "attempt_id=plan_id", "request_id=plan_id", "student-diagnostic-assessment-reservation.v1", "diagnostic-placement.v1", "diagnostic-placement-band-v1", "diagnostic-placement-route-v1", "START_FOUNDATION", "START_CORE", "START_ADVANCED", "BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE", "reservation_json - 'schema' - 'id'"} {
		if !strings.Contains(s, want) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", want)
		}
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"answers_json", "items_json", "mastery_json", "learning_path_id", "scorer_json"} {
		if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(s), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("unsafe migration column %q", forbidden)
		}
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticBootstrapMigrationPinsBindingTimeAndHasNoSeed(t *testing.T) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../db/migrations/013_diagnostic_bootstrap_binding_and_receipt.up.sql")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s := string(b)
	for _, want := range []string{"CREATE TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_binding", "CREATE TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_receipt", "binding_created_at", "receipt_json->>'binding_created_at'", "::timestamptz=binding_created_at", "active boolean NOT NULL", "BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE", "No seed row"} {
		if !strings.Contains(s, want) {
			t.Fatalf("missing %s", want)
		}
	}
	if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(s), "INSERT INTO DIAGNOSTIC_BOOTSTRAP_BINDING") {
		t.Fatal("binding migration must not seed a course")
	}
}
